title: The Learning Contract and its Impact on Scholarship among Moroccan Nursing Students
reason: Perception questionnaire on an e-learning learning contract among 58 nursing students, reported descriptively. All data are self-report; no platform-recorded indicator or activity product is related to success or a construct.

extraction.country: Morocco (Higher Institute of Nursing and Health Techniques, Casablanca)
extraction.n_quote: A group of 58 students participated in a survey conducted by questionnaire, with a response rate of 86.20%.
extraction.population: semester-4 multi-skilled nursing students (professional licence), 1 institute
extraction.notes: Response rate 86.20% of 58 implies about 50 respondents; analysed n not stated separately.
